field_principles.continuous_self_learning_task: Must be true -- FR-11 mandate requires at least one CSL task per milestone.
field_principles.fr11_fst_eval_passed: Boolean gate for exp2242. True only when sample_efficiency_ratio >= 2.0 AND kl_drift_ratio <= 0.5.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefix required. Use complete: if both acceptance gates pass.
field_principles.kl_drift_ratio: Secondary FST gate: <= 0.5 validates 70% KL reduction claim.
field_principles.n_corpus: Records corpus size so statistical significance is auditable.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Lists which resources were verified before running; pre-empts fabrication.
field_principles.sample_efficiency_ratio: Primary FST gate: >= 2.0 validates the 3x claim from arXiv:2605.12484.
field_principles.utility_delta: Measures raw FR-11 benefit -- energy reduction delta between regimes.
